current_native_donor.role: strong present-day specialist donor; not historical-original source

current_reconstructed_grammar.body_form: jumpmap NAME { from PATH; case VALUE [when GUARD] -> TARGET [do ACTION]; else -> TARGET [do ACTION] }
current_reconstructed_grammar.ir: JMPJumpGraphSet -> JMPJumpGraph with source/case/fallback nodes and guarded-jump edges
current_reconstructed_grammar.runtime: JMPTransition with selected target, cloned next-state, trace and receipt

semantic_boundary.meaning: a transition selects a route from current state while preserving the incoming state body unless an explicit transition action changes it
semantic_boundary.guard_law: VALUE MATCH != GUARANTEED JUMP; DECLARED GUARD STILL GOVERNS

maturation_obligations: prove a value-matched case with a failed guard can fall through to a later valid case
prove explicit fallback remains distinct from a matched case
prove missing matching case and missing fallback fail closed
prove actionless transitions preserve state content while returning a separate next-state object
prove named-map selection and unknown-map rejection
prove selected target, state and trace are deterministic
maintain historicalRecoveryClaim=false until stronger historical source is actually recovered
claim_ceiling: no claim that a value match bypasses its guard
keeper: RECOVER BEFORE REBUILD; WHEN RECOVERY DOES NOT YIELD THE ORIGINAL, BUILD FORWARD WITHOUT FORGING AN ANCESTOR.
